entities.summary: The Museum of the Sahrawi people's Liberation Army is located in the Rabouni refugee camp,which is one of the Sahrawi refugee camps, in the southwest of Algeria. This museum is dedicated to the struggle for the independence of the Sahrawi people. It presents weapons, vehicles and uniforms used as well as abundant documentation history.
